title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
abstract: arXiv:2610.40611v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures

translated_title: 何时协助与建议什么：在单个紧凑解码器中联合实现门控与基于记忆的提示生成
translated_abstract: 主动式助手在对话过程中提供简短的、基于记忆的提示，决定何时协助以及建议什么内容。当前系统将这一任务拆分给一个门控模块和一个更大的生成器；我们在28,058个决策点上对二者进行了联合评估。分阶段生成的分数是理想门控下的上限：在真实门控下，端到端精确匹配得分为0.2619（上限为0.2971），端到端精确率为0.2387，仍有较大提升空间。门控的价值体现在精确率和计算量节省上，其计算节省幅度从使用8B生成器时的4.39倍降至使用1B生成器时的1.38倍。记忆档案是提示质量的关键驱动因素：移除它会导致精确匹配损失24.7分（重新缩放的BERTScore从0.57降至0.35），而引入检索和更大的生成器在精确匹配上并未带来任何提升。一个1B解码器可以同时完成两项任务：从中间层进行门控，并在同一遍前向传播中生成提示。在其最终检查点，该模型在自动端到端指标上达到或超越了两模型流水线。
tldr: 本文提出仅用一个紧凑的1B参数解码器，在同一遍前向传播中通过中间层门控联合完成“何时介入”与“生成基于记忆的提示”两项任务，其端到端表现达到或超越传统双模型流水线，并揭示记忆档案（而非检索或更大生成器）才是决定提示质量的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a single compact 1B decoder can jointly perform gating (deciding when to assist) and memory-grounded hint generation in one pass, matching or exceeding two-model pipelines on end-to-end metrics, while revealing that the memory profile—not retrieval or a larger generator—is the key driver of hint quality.
